prompt: Build a modular Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) Provider in C# structured into: (1) OpenID Connect Authorization Endpoint issuing JWT tokens, (2) User Directory Service managing password hashing and account locking, and (3) Token Revocation Subsystem tracking blacklisted session tokens.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Oidc Score: 0-5 (Evaluates JWT signing and claim formatting)
Module 2 Directory Score: 0-5 (Evaluates secure password hashing like BCrypt/Argon2)
Module 3 Revocation Score: 0-5 (Evaluates token blacklist caching and lookup speed)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates authentication pipeline security and reliability)
